product_information.title: Indication
product_information.value:
Xeloda is indicated for the adjuvant treatment of patients following surgery of stage III (Dukes’ stage C) colon cancer.
Xeloda is indicated for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer.
Xeloda is indicated for first-line treatment of advanced gastric cancer in combination with a platinumbased regimen. Xeloda in combination with docetaxel is indicated for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after failure of cytotoxic chemotherapy. Previous therapy should have included an anthracycline. Xeloda is also indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after failure of taxanes and an anthracyclinecontaining chemotherapy regimen or for whom further anthracycline therapy is not indicated.
